id: title:darkopia:resolve cohort conditions against membership in flag tester

review.posthog_relevance: Adds cohort membership resolution and caching to the feature flag evaluation and condition analysis API, allowing the system to account for cohort membership when determining property matches and generating explanations.
review.reason: The implementation adds cohort membership as an optional parameter to the condition analysis builder and includes cohort membership resolution and caching, including a new helper to resolve cohort matches and a dedicated analysis path. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation, but the actual benefit and reliability improvement are not independently verified.
